hook:
A tiny OLED counts
up on a Pico.
kicker: Raspberry Pi Pico + SSD1306 OLED over I2C

roles.raspberry-pi-pico: Runs the sketch and drives the OLED
roles.velxio-ssd1306-i2c-4pin: Shows Hello Velxio and a counter

igCaption: A Raspberry Pi Pico drives a 4-pin SSD1306 OLED over I2C. The sketch prints Hello Velxio and a counter that ticks up every half second. Only four wires: power, ground, SDA and SCL.
ytTitle: Pico + SSD1306 OLED counter in 4 wires #shorts
ytDescription: A Raspberry Pi Pico talks to a 4-pin SSD1306 OLED over I2C and shows a live counter. The sketch uses Adafruit GFX and SSD1306 libraries on SDA GP4 and SCL GP5. Open it in your browser: https://velxio.dev/example/pico-oled-4pin-i2c
